content.short: ArbiPad is a next-generation crowdfunding launchpad for tokenized gaming and metaverse projects, developed in partnership with Good Games Guild.
content.description: ArbiPad is a decentralized launchpad and crowdfunding platform developed in partnership with Good Games Guild (GGG), providing curated early access to promising blockchain gaming and metaverse token sales. GGG's extensive gaming community provides both credibility and distribution for projects launching on ArbiPad. Deployed on Mantle, ArbiPad gives Mantle users privileged access to vetted early-stage gaming token launches in the ecosystem.
content.meta: ArbiPad is a launchpad for tokenized gaming projects backed by Good Games Guild on Mantle. Discover ArbiPad on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
